items.q: Why does Veitch answer scam email?
items.a: Not to be mean. Other baiters do cruel things. **Minutes with him are minutes not spent on vulnerable adults.** He ran it for three years. Solomon alone lasted weeks.

items.q: What is the only operator rule?
items.a: **Pseudonymous inbox.** He started on his real address. Mornings became a thousand penis-enlargement emails. Burn account, then reply.

items.q: How did the Solomon gold thread grow?
items.a: 25 kg → 50 kg → he demanded a **metric ton**. Job: hedge-fund executive bank manager. Fake board chart. Spend the cut on **hummus**. Friends asked him out; he was waiting on bullion email.

items.q: What is the candy code, and did it work?
items.a: Lawyer = Gummy Bear, bank = Creme Egg, legal = Fizzy Cola Bottle, claim = Peanut M&Ms, documents = Jelly Beans, Western Union = Giant Gummy Lizard; call him **KitKat**. Solomon wrote it back and asked for £1,500 via a Giant Gummy Lizard.

items.q: How did the Winnie Mandela pitch close?
items.a: $45M because of Nelson's health — **three months after he died** ('fairly serious'). She wanted $3,000 and signed **ONE LOVE**. He answered **NO WOMAN, NO CRY**, then **I SHOT THE SHERIFF**.
